theirReference: I'm sincerely thankful to Cristian and His Gf who took me for an afternoon walk around the City. I really appreciate your time, hospitality and thouhgtfulness. They showed me hidden gems to local favourite drinks and street food. Able to visit His all time favourite store and had (Cholao), I loved it. I had fun feeding the pigeons in the square, visited some of the best photographed graffiti and well known streets. Cristian knows where to take good photo and videos and He himself is a great videographer. It was a short time meet up but full of fun and memories with them. Cristian is very kind, down to earth guy, time with him and his Gf was easy and fun. Bro, you are always welcome to Canada. Pls let me know and I will be glad to show you around. Again, big thank you for your hospitality and kindness. -Will
myReference: I had a great time hosting Will here in Bogotá! We went for a walk around the city, took some pictures and videos, and I showed him some of my favorite spots. He was curious, respectful, and really interested in the local culture. He even tried a traditional Colombian dessert and loved it! Will is easygoing, friendly, and great company — I really enjoyed spending time with him. I’d definitely recommend him to other hosts in the Couchsurfing community! Count on me anytime you come Bogotá :)
